stem:
The box plot summarizes the finishing times for the runners in a race.

Which statement is best supported by the data in the box plot?

options.label: F
options.text: Approximately 50% of the finishing times were less than 25 minutes.

options.label: G
options.text: Approximately \( \frac{1}{4} \) of the finishing times were greater than 28 minutes.

options.label: H
options.text: Approximately 25% of the finishing times were in the interval 20–22 minutes.

options.label: J
options.text: Approximately \( \frac{3}{4} \) of the finishing times were in the interval 15–30 minutes.

visual_elements: box plot with scale from 14 to 32, minimum near 16, Q1 near 20, median near 22, Q3 near 25, maximum near 30
